name: The Adventuring Party
description: A band of adventurers gathers at the tavern — each a different race, wielding a different weapon. Work out who's who.
clues: Wrenna, Human, and Greataxe go with 24 gp, 34 gp, and 54 gp, in some order.
Exactly one of these is true: Orin goes with Tiefling; Gnome goes with Quarterstaff; Longbow goes with 44 gp.
Either Wrenna goes with Tiefling or 24 gp goes with Quarterstaff.
If Sable goes with Greataxe, then either Gnome goes with 34 gp or Dragonborn goes with Thorne.
54 gp goes with at least two of Sable, Tiefling, and Longbow.
Crossbow, Longbow, and Quarterstaff go with Orin, 24 gp, and 44 gp, in some order.
